units: <cite ref="Berakhot 55a:1">Ber. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>שלשה דברים … וע׳ ת׳ וכ׳</he> three things cause a man’s record of sins to be called up: a threatening wall, calculation on prayer &c., v. <cite ref="D00635"><he>דִּין</he> II</cite>.
